rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for unfair or prejudicial treatment based on a group or category.

example.english: The company shouldn’t allow discrimination against job applicants because of age.
example.traditional: 公司唔應該因為年齡而歧視求職者。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 m4 jing1 goi1 jan1 wai6 nin4 ling4 ji4 kei4 si6 kau4 zik1 ze2

rows.note: Use this noun phrase for the ability to tell things apart accurately and make sound distinctions.

example.english: My dog’s discrimination is so good that it can tell which one is genuine just by hearing it.
example.traditional: 我隻狗嘅分辨能力好強，一聽就知邊隻係真貨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 gau2 ge3 fan1 bin6 nang4 lik6 hou2 koeng4 jat1 teng1 zau6 zi1 bin1 zek3 hai6 zan1 fo3

rows.note: Use this for discrimination expressed as refined taste or aesthetic judgment.

example.english: They have excellent discrimination in fashion, and their whole outfit looks great.
example.traditional: 佢揀衫好有品味，成身造型都好靚。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gaan2 saam1 hou2 jau5 ban2 mei6 seng4 san1 zou6 jing4 dou1 hou2 leng3
